fact: Webmanagercenter, citing Nouakchott Innovation Lab, says the 2025 Fintech Mauritanie Hackathon logged 150 projects and four then joined the Lab's accompaniment pipeline.

The Africa Capital Report says the Central Bank of Mauritania's DigiLab and BCM Fintech Program give selected teams three-month accompaniment including incubation, and Nouakchott Innovation Lab runs a local Founder Institute chapter.
GIZ Mauritanie says the Hadina RIMTIC incubator launches in October 2026 a support programme for nine selected startups, including three Gouvathon winners.

The Islamic Development Bank notice says an IsDB grant co-financed by IICO funds setting up the BINA business incubator in Nouakchott, with consultants sought for 15 months of support to 100 startups.

InnovRIM, operator of SahelFabLab, is running the Agri-Innovation Start-Up Cup 2026 with FAO and ILO, planning 20 startups across Bassiknou and Dar Naim with a three-day bootcamp and six weeks of incubation and mentoring.
Cridem reports Hadina-RIMTIC, a business incubator founded in 2014, opened applications to 26 May 2025 for the second cohort of its CATAL1.5T pre-acceleration programme in Mauritania and Niger.
